scope: Review of repair for root finding: ARM-only GPIO preparation ran unconditionally for x86 support builds.
checks: The x86 return occurs before any ARM path access, command execution or report mutation.
The existing ARM GPIO patch body and input/derived identity checks are preserved in one function. No second implementation is introduced.
The caller invokes the stage only after prior success; x86 retains success without ARM output claims.
The regression invokes the production function with an absent ARM tree: x86 skips and ARM rejects. A malformed ARM parent also rejects before a patch tool can run.
The already frozen ARM513j build has unchanged branch behavior. Its success must not be reused as a current-source hash match.
disposition: Source review closed. Actual focused and integration checks remain required.
